title: Site & Project Engineers (EOI), Victoria
content_text: Expressions of interest for Site Engineers and Project Engineers on civil/infrastructure projects across Victoria (roads, bridges, earthworks, renewables). Plan, schedule and deliver site works; manage subcontractors, labour and plant; cost tracking, variations and progress claims; safety, quality and environmental compliance. About you: relevant Civil Engineering degree; demonstrated experience working on Major Infrastructure Projects; strong demonstrated civil construction background (roads, earthworks, drainage, structures preferred); valid driver's licence. Advert says applicants not meeting 100% of criteria may still apply.
apply_instructions: Apply through the Fulton Hogan Workday portal (requisition R26927).
